{{Quote|This is a dangerous area. You should head back because if you get lost, no one will find you.|[[Tombl Blaus]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FomatF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Quest: "Find out more about the Fryer"}}</ref>}}
The '''Poacher vs. Creature Battle''' was the name of an especially prolonged conflict between [[Hunting/Legends|poachers]] and violent packs of [[Squall (species)|squalls]] and [[vrobal]]s on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Pelts of Rori creatures usually fetched handsome sums on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] and unscrupulous poachers did not care about destroying the entire ecosystem.<ref name="SWG:PvCB" /> In addition to the many hunters and poachers, the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] by the name of [[Tombl Blaus]] was situated within the battle.<ref name="SWG:FomatF" /> Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] visited the battle zone to recover a [[R2a Astromech Head|head]] belonging to an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]].<ref name="SWG:UA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Unknown Astromech}}</ref> Around this time, a spacer also spoke to Tombl Blaus to help reverse [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] a [[Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer|Corellian fried ice cream fryer]].<ref name="SWG:FomatF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Poacher vs. Creature Battle appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG:PvCB" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Poacher vs. Creature Battle was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
